title: SMOK Arco Digi Pod Vape Kit
description: The Smok Arco Digi Pod Vape Kit is a sleek and intelligent refillable device designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping. Its built-in 1300mAh battery delivers dependable all-day performance, while USB-C fast charging ensures a rapid power-up when needed. With three selectable power levels (ECO, NOM, MAX), the Arco Digi offers a tailored vaping experience across a 5W–30W range. The adjustable airflow slider gives you added control over draw resistance, while the discreet 0.84" LCD screen displays power level, wattage, and puff count at a glance. The included 2ml pod is pre-installed with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, ideal for either RDL or a more open MTL draw. Best suited to 50/50 freebase or 10mg Nic Salts, this coil strikes a balance between flavour clarity and smooth vapour. The Arco Digi is compatible with Smok’s full range of Arco pods, including: 0.4ohm (loose RDL with higher vapour, best with High-VG or low-nicotine e-liquids) 0.6ohm (loose RDL/MTL draw with medium cloud and good flavour) 0.8ohm (smooth, tighter MTL draw with bold flavour) 1.1ohm (tight MTL, discreet vapour, optimal for higher-strength Nic Salts) Features like smart pod detection, auto wattage matching, and safety protections make this a reliable, customisable pod kit ideal for everyday use. Shop vape juice online and find the flavour that feels like it was made for this kit. We recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid with this kit Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
